text:
Aisha (CSM): Quick sync - Willow Labs onboarding: we might hit multiple small incidents that cumulatively trigger >25% credits under current rules. Need to lock down cap and external wording.
Priya (Ops): Saw the same in the sim. Two overlapping imports + a brief rate-limit backoff gave two separate latency breaches and one 90s outage from job retry storm.
Marco (Renewals): Renewal team worried this sounds like product instability. We need a POC-friendly message and a cap so renewal conversations don't derail.
Leah (Finance): From finance side, stacking is OK but we prefer a predictable maximum per onboarding phase. Suggest cap = 15% per 7 days for onboarding plans.
Tom (Support): Draft external note v0: "During your onboarding we observed transient latency and an import retry loop which impacted throughput. Per the SLA we will issue service credits for measured SLO breaches. We are implementing a cap for onboarding windows to avoid excessive stacking."
Aisha (CSM): Good. Can you add a customer-facing example showing how credits are calculated so folks can see the math? Also include an action item: contact CSM within 7 days to discuss credits.
Tom (Support): Example snippet: 
```
Window: 7 days
Incident 1: 2m outage -> uptime breach -> credit 7%
Incident 2: latency p95 hit for 15m -> credit 5%
Stacked total (no cap): 12%
With proposed cap (15%/7d): final credit = 12%
If incidents aggregated exceeded cap, credit = cap.
```
Priya (Ops): Ops note: we can add a rule to the calculator to detect "onboarding" tag and apply cap automatically. Should we make cap opt-in for enterprise customers?
Leah (Finance): For enterprise we can offer opt-out (i.e., let credits stack) if they sign a deviation addendum. Otherwise default cap applies.
Marco (Renewals): That helps. Also: add a non-alarmist bullet explaining typical causes (imports, cache warmups, routing changes) and mitigation steps customers can take.
Aisha (CSM): Good. Also update our renewal risk scorecard: if projected aggregate credit > 10% over 90d, flag for executive review.
eng-monitor-bot: incident willow-import-retries -> closed (3182468255) :white_check_mark: metrics snapshot attached
Priya (Ops): Actionables:
- Priya: implement onboarding tag in credits-calc and simulate multi-import overlap (due tomorrow)
- Tom: publish external note + worked example + link to credits-calc (due EOD)
- Leah: confirm cap percentage with FP&A and legal (due 48h)
- Marco: update renewal playbook to surface credit exposure as a renewal risk signal (due 72h)
Aisha (CSM): Cool. Tom, please use phrase "we will apply" not "we have applied" until finance confirms and legal signs off. Keep tone calm and helpful.
Tom (Support): Ack. Will push to Drive and ping Legal. link: https://redwood.example/sla/onboarding-cap
Leah (Finance): FYI, if we cap too low we risk customer pushback. I'll model three cap tiers and share economics.
Marco (Renewals): If Willow execs ask, I'll offer a call to walk through the calculation and mitigation plan.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team. This should reduce surprise credits and give Sales/renewals a clear script. I'll close the loop after Leah confirms the cap.
eng-monitor-bot: daily uptime digest attached (3182468398)
Aisha (CSM): ending thread - will summarize & add to onboarding playbook."
